text: Wheeler summarized the Einstein field equations as a two-way coupling: matter tells spacetime how to curve, and spacetime tells matter how to ___.
explanation: Wheeler's epigram captures the reciprocal content of G_μν = 8πG T_μν/c⁴: the stress-energy tensor T_μν sources the curvature G_μν (matter curves spacetime), and matter in turn follows geodesics of that curved geometry (spacetime tells matter how to move). The word completing the phrase is 'move'.
